# Maverick Energy Partners

> Dallas-based land acquisition firm that buys Texas land near electrical substations and high-voltage transmission lines, directly from landowners, for data center development. Texas only: all six ERCOT zones plus the Entergy Texas area of East Texas.

Maverick Energy Partners screens every tract for grid capacity (138 kV minimum, 345 kV priority), title, floodplain, water and county posture before making an offer. Typical terms are a short paid option period followed by a cash closing. Landowners, heirs and brokers can request a free screen; there is no listing, commission or obligation. Contact: info@maverickenergypartners.com.
